scripts.mobile:web:preview: npm run dashboard:build && npm run dashboard:start -- --port 4173
scripts.test: npm run test -w @slugswap/dashboard && npm run test -w @slugswap/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run root:typecheck && npm run dashboard:typecheck && npm run mobile:typecheck
scripts.story:generate:svg: npx dotenv-cli -e .env -- npx tsx scripts/instagram-stories/write-instagram-story-data.ts && npx tsx scripts/instagram-stories/generate-instagram-story.ts
scripts.mobile:eas:build:ios: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.mobile:eas:build:ios:local: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production --local
scripts.mobile:eas:submit:ios: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli submit --platform ios --profile production --latest
scripts.mobile:eas:testflight: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli build -p ios --profile production --submit
scripts.mobile:eas:update: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli update --channel production
scripts.mobile:eas:update:preview: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli update --channel preview
scripts.ci:check: npm run typecheck && npm run db:migrations:check
